clues.text: In Egypt, he asked his brothers to come near and told them he was the brother they had sold.
He told his brothers a dream in which the sun, moon and eleven stars bowed down to him.
His brothers pulled him out of a pit and sold him to Ishmaelites for twenty shekels of silver.
In Egypt, his master's wife grabbed his cloak, but he left it in her hand and ran outside.
Israel loved this son born in his old age more than the others and made him a robe of many colors.
Pharaoh put his own signet ring on this man's finger and a gold chain around his neck.
Standing before Pharaoh, he said the king's dreams were one and the same, showing what God was about to do.
